title: Origin
author: Dan Brown
summary: Robert Langdon attends a museum event in Bilbao where a former student plans to reveal a discovery that will shake the world's religions. The presentation is cut short, and Langdon is soon being pursued.
readIf: you want another fast, puzzle-filled Langdon chase through art, architecture and big ideas.
skipIf: you want fresh storytelling; the formula and its cliffhanger chapters are in full force.

pairings.reason: The first Langdon novel, whose mix of hidden history and brisk chapters is the template here.
An earlier thriller by the same author that also centres on powerful computing and secrecy.
A science-driven thriller with a bigger, stranger central idea and a similar breakneck feel.
